note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are our own words, written from the official descriptions and the cited sources; where a place or step is not pinned down yet, the guide says so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so it arrives on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are done. There is no separate task behind it, which makes it a progress marker rather than a goal to chase directly. The road to it is the whole guide: five story chapters, the 100% completion checklist, every activity and every collectible set. Plan on roughly 200 hours from the first mission to the last trophy, at the 4-out-of-10 difficulty the guide sites put on the platinum. Keep a save at the start of each chapter, since the game has no mission replay, and keep cheats off, because they switch trophies off.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the first story trophy, and it pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which is also Jason's first mission. You cannot miss it: just play the story from the start and follow the mission prompts until the mission ends. It is the natural first tick on the checklist and needs no preparation at all. Because there is no mission replay, your only safety net is a save at the start of Chapter 1, but nothing in this mission can lock you out of anything later.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and this unlocks when the chapter closes. It cannot be missed, but Chapter 1 holds the one thing in the whole list that can be: the first meditation, on the balcony at Jason's house, which only appears in this chapter. After the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her when she talks about meditating, and accept the prompt on the balcony. Do that before the chapter ends, then keep playing the story; the trophy itself will pop at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist and this gold trophy pops. It is the hardest trophy on the list and the longest grind, around 100 hours after the story. The checklist only becomes viewable after the credits, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but everything you do during the story already counts. The published checklist has 35 lines, and the big ones are: 42 of 42 shooting range gold medals, 10 of 13 race challenge golds, 30 of 40 unique races won, 42 of 42 drone time trials, 200 of 277 vehicle models, 100 of 255 animals, 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vault robberies, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts and 15 of 18 meditations. Work on the vehicle scans and animal studies from the start, since they take the longest to accumulate, and leave the nastiest 10 challenges undone: only 70 of 80 are needed.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida and this silver pops. A stunt is a jump, a near miss, a drift or any of the other driving feats the game counts, and there are 397 of them in the world, so you do not need anywhere near all of them. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep doing stunts past this trophy and the extra 50 will count there. The fastest way is to string jumps and drifts together on the highways and around the stunt jumps marked on the map, in a fast car with good handling. It all counts in free roam, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once and this pops. The nine are: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race all count) and a stunt. None of them needs to be finished or won beyond the one named: a single basket, a single race win, a single stunt. The shooting range needs the $5 waiver pass from the clerk before its challenges appear. Work through the list in free roam whenever you pass an activity, and check your progress under Progress, then Activities, to see which types are still untried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread over 12 courses at two ranges. Griffin Shooting Range in the north-west of Vice City (Balsero) has 6 moving courses with 3 gold difficulties each, 18 golds in all: 3-Point, Hook, Loop, Maze, Compound and Villa. Rodgers Ranch in the north-east of Port Gellhorn has 6 stationary score courses with 4 gold difficulties each, 24 golds: Market, Zombie, Hunting, Saloon, Cops and Robbers and Alien. At each range, buy the $5 waiver pass from the clerk first, which marks the challenges on the map; rented weapons cost $10 and are good enough for gold. On Griffin's moving courses, keep a steady route and save Focus for the small spinning targets; on Rodgers' stationary courses, build the score multiplier with controlled body hits before a headshot. Track medals under Progress, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges, or find the ranges under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges. All 42 golds are also on the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations and this pops. There are 42 races in all, three per location, and each is a time trial: fly the drone around the course against a par time. You only need one win per location for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42, so finishing each location while you are there saves a return trip. The third race at a location stays locked until you beat par on the first two, so 28 of the 42 need a par time and the third only needs finishing. The locations run south to north and include Hamlet, Watson Bay, Capri, Buckskin Swamp, Balsero, Downtown, Dalton Island, Vice Beach, Port Gellhorn, Draper Island, Moreau Sawmill and Millport, with Ambrosia and Waning Sands completing the set; Dalton Island is only reachable by boat or aircraft, everywhere else a taxi will do. Find them on the map under Activities, then Top Fun Drones, and track them under Progress, then Activities.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 meditations in all, spread over 10 spots. Eight outdoor spots count twice, once for Jason and once for Lucia, the Chapter 1 balcony session counts once, and the final Ascent meditation on the Mount Kalaga summit counts once and only appears on the map after the other 17 are done. The spots are: Jason's house balcony in Key Lento (Chapter 1 only, missable), Smooth Sand on the sandbar off Belpoint west of Capri, the Swamp dock in Buckskin Swamp, Worn Stone on the Emerald River bank at Camp Moonflower, Red Rocks in Manifest Canyon where the rail tracks cross the highway, the Water Wheel by the ruined paper mill in southern Moreau, the Jutting Cliff in Mount Kalaga National Park, the Waterfall north-west of Tallaloko, the Seaside outcrop east of Waning Sands, and the Ascent stone circle on the Mount Kalaga summit. Do the Chapter 1 balcony session first: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is the only spot that disappears for good, and the guides have not confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. Spots show as purple icons once you get close, and your count lives under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations; the map filter is Exploration, then Meditate Around Leonida. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18, but this trophy wants all of them.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back to back with your partner, without losing your wanted level, and this pops. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well for this, since they are close together. Go in with your partner, rob each one in turn, and keep moving between them without letting the wanted level drop: the trophy is about the chain, not about escaping cleanly. Note that it pops late, about half a minute after the third robbery, so do not assume it failed if nothing happens at once. If the wanted level drops between shops, the chain breaks and you start the count again.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus and this pops. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode, and the trick is to set it up before the fight: top up your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, carry Adrenaline, and bring an assault rifle. The guides report that it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick a fight with gang members at one of their illegal operations, where five enemies are close together. Trigger Focus once you are in range, and drop all five before it runs out. If it fails, refill focus and try again at another operation.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino, the game's tank, and the description is a joke rather than an instruction. The published guides have not pinned down the exact trigger yet, so it is not yet checked in the game whether the trophy wants you to steal a Rhino, drive one, destroy one, or survive one. Tanks show up when the wanted level climbs high and around military spots, so a practical first try is to push the wanted level up, steal a Rhino when one rolls in, and drive it clear. If that does not pop it, destroying one is the next thing to try. Keep this one for the cleanup phase, when a failed attempt costs nothing.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected and this pops. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City are the obvious candidates, the same ones that work for Retail Therapy, so you can scout them while doing that trophy. Go in quietly: move slowly, stay out of the guards' and cameras' lines of sight, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. The guides have not pinned down the exact detection rules yet, so whether a silent alarm or a single witness breaks it is not yet checked in the game. If you are spotted, leave, let the heat die down and try another store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one, and this silver pops. Bank vaults are robbed during bank jobs: the 100% checklist counts 22 bank jobs and 8 bank vault robberies, so keep robbing past this trophy and the extra three count there. Each vault robbery raises the wanted level sharply, which is why this pairs well with Hot Together, since a vault robbery is the fastest way to a four-star wanted level. After each vault, break the line of sight, get out of the red heat zone and let the wanted level fall before the next one. Five escapes, not five attempts, is what counts.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape, and this pops. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida, so find one on the road, stop it, break it open and take the cash inside. The robbery will raise your wanted level, so have an escape route in mind before you start: a fast car nearby, or a tunnel or alley where the police lose sight of you. It is a free-roam trophy with no story gate, so try it whenever you spot a truck, and if the first attempt goes wrong, another truck will come along.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida and this pops. An area counts once you have been through it, so the work is mostly driving: cover the map county by county, from Vice City out through the swamps, the farmland, the coast and the mountains. It pairs naturally with the other exploration goals, since the same trips cover the meditation spots, the card sets, the WAiNK locations and the vehicle scans. Check the map to see which areas are still unvisited, and use a fast car or a plane for the far corners. Everything is reachable in free roam after the story, so nothing can be missed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs and this pops. Illegal operations are the gang-run spots around Leonida, marked on the map, and each gang owns some of them. Hit one operation per gang: go in, take what is there and get out. The 100% checklist wants 39 gang operations robbed in all, so keep hitting them past this trophy and the extra operations count there. Gang members at the operations also make good targets for the Gunslinger trophy, since the guides report that trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Work through the gangs one by one and track which ones you have done.

If it is tied to a story beat, it will pop on its own while you play through; if it is an activity, the partner activities like Hot Together and Retail Therapy are the closest neighbours. Pick a quiet stretch of road where you will not pick up an instant wanted level you cannot handle, and make sure the swing connects while the car is moving. One clean hit should do it; if it does not pop, try again with a faster pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts and this pops. Marked bills come from robberies, and your contacts are the fences who will clean them for you, taking a cut. Track your total through the money screens, and expect this to land naturally during the robbery grind for the other trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops and this pops. The total is cumulative and counts every shop in the game: clothes, food and drink, weapons and ammo, car parts, whatever you buy. Money flows fast in this game once the robberies start, and a hundred thousand is not much against the cost of cars, weapons and property, so this will usually pop on its own during a normal playthrough. If you are close and want to finish it, buy a car upgrade or a round of ammo and watch the total tip over. It is a free-roam trophy with no window and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties and this pops. Garages are bought through the property listings, and they give you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect, which matters for the vehicle goals. They are not cheap, so the sensible order is to buy them as the money comes in from robberies and missions, rather than saving for them early when the cash is better spent on weapons and cars. There are 8 in all, spread across the map, and each purchase is permanent. Once the eighth is yours, the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app and this pops. Any ten vehicles count, so use the common ones you see every day rather than hunting rare models for this.
